segments.title: Chương 12: Đần độn, năm nghìn tiền thưởng vào tay
segments.content:
Chapter 12: Dumbfounded, the 5000 Reward is Secured

"Hiss!" Xu Qianqian sucked in a sharp breath. "Be gentler." "Yeah, right. Who told you not to watch where you were going on the stairs?" Jiang Nian lowered his head, massaging her ankle seriously, vaguely seeing the bluish veins under her snow-white skin.

A thought popped into his head out of nowhere: what if she wore white stockings…

No, no, this is Xu Qianqian.

Jiang Nian couldn't help but shake his head, tossing the messy thoughts from his mind. It wasn't that a childhood friend was out of the question, he just hadn't expected Xu Qianqian to have developed such a girlish charm.

"How is this my fault? I told you... there was a mouse," she pouted, her gaze shifting downward.

The strong scent of medicinal wine for bruises filled the air. The back of the boy rubbing her foot was as straight as a young poplar tree, his shoulders were broad, and his black hair was thick.

A thought popped into her head out of nowhere: maybe I should go watch him play basketball next time?

No, no, what on earth am I doing? This is Jiang Nian!

The Jiang Nian I hate the most!

"So what if there's a mouse? Mice have lives too, you know," Jiang Nian didn't continue, changing the subject. "Have you estimated your score yet? What do you think you'll get this time?"

"Um... 630, probably."

"You're a monster. Why don't you just go to Class Zero?" Jiang Nian was shocked, and the speed of his rubbing hands increased, warming up the sprained area.

Xu Qianqian thought for a moment. "Don't want to move. I'm used to it here."

After applying the medicine, Jiang Nian went back across the hall to his own home to sleep. After he left, Xu Qianqian dazedly fell asleep on the sofa. The sound of a key in the door was heard.

Xu Zewen dragged his exhausted body home from work, pushed open the door, and sniffed, then saw his daughter sleeping on the sofa.

"Dad?" Xu Qianqian woke up in a daze and rubbed her eyes. "You're off work?"

She was about to get up but was immediately stopped by Director Xu.

"What's wrong with your foot?"

"I twisted it on the stairs, but I've already put medicine on it." Xu Qianqian stood up with a limp, forcing a smile onto her face. "See? I'm fine."

Director Xu grunted in acknowledgment and told her to apply more medicine tomorrow.

The next day.

Jiang Nian woke up early as usual to buy breakfast downstairs. Before going up, he saw Lao Xu driving off to work early from a distance. His parents weren't awake yet, so he put the breakfast on the table and went across the hall to apply medicine for Xu Qianqian.

Morning self-study started at 7:30. Xu Qianqian, dragging her sprained foot, had already washed up.

"Is it any better?" He placed the breakfast down, squatted, and began searching for the medicinal wine. "Why did Uncle Xu go to work so early?"

"His department has a project, they've been busy with it." Xu Qianqian's eyes dimmed for a moment.

"Oh~ It's fine if your dad is busy. Your other dad will put medicine on for you."

"Go die!"

Xu Qianqian kicked him with her uninjured foot. The two started bickering, and the atmosphere became cheerful again.

Downstairs.

Carrying her schoolbag, Xu Qianqian looked in surprise at Jiang Nian, who was riding over on a small electric scooter.

"If you take it, how will Auntie Li get to work?"

"Get on, stop being so long-winded." Jiang Nian braked and said impatiently, "Lao Jiang isn't working today. He's driving my mom to her office."

"You're the one who's long-winded!" Xu Qianqian was still indignant after getting on the back seat.

After thinking it over, she opened Jiang Nian's chat window on WeChat and changed his nickname from "Annoying Pest" to "Long-winded Annoying Pest".

Just as they left the alley, Jiang Nian slammed on the brakes.

Caught off guard, Xu Qianqian crashed right into his back, the soft mounds of her chest fiercely compressed. Her pupils constricted, and her face flushed red at a speed visible to the naked eye.

"Jiang Nian, are you trying to get killed?!"

"Wait, I'm thinking." Jiang Nian opened the panel that only he could see. He looked at the words "Mission Complete" and was completely bewildered.

[Mission: Defeat the formidable love rival Zhou Haifei, making him give up on Xu Qianqian. Reward: 5000 RMB (Completed).]

His phone buzzed. His bank card balance changed from 2131 to 7131 RMB.

He looked around. The streets were filled with students heading to morning self-study. It was Monday, so they had to wear school uniforms for the flag-raising ceremony. All he could see was a sea of white summer uniforms. Jiang Nian thought about it but still had no clue, so he decided to ignore it for now.

"Did you do that on purpose just now?" Xu Qianqian asked bleakly from the back seat.

"No, there was a mouse in front of the scooter, it scared me." Jiang Nian was a bit preoccupied and casually made something up. "I was afraid I'd run it over, red and white guts splattering everywhere—"

"Gag!" Xu Qianqian punched him and said angrily, "Stop talking!"

After the flag-raising ceremony, the papers for the first period, Chinese, began to be handed out.

Jiang Nian was sprawled on his desk, still unable to figure it out. How could that glasses-wearing girl, his aluminum-copper brother, give up just like that? It felt like he hadn't even had a chance to do anything.

Giving up on love at such a young age.

Oh, wonderful.

Jiang Nian's own understanding of love was rather shallow; he was someone destined for divorce in the future. Compared to pursuing love, he'd rather make more money and, if he had the time, get with a few more girls.

When poor, one cultivates oneself in solitude; when successful, one brings benefit to all under heaven.

At the front of the class, the Chinese teacher was handing out papers, reading out a few scores that were above passing.

"Zhou Yuting, 90. Ren Dong, 104. Chen Lili, 117…"

Suddenly, she paused. "Jiang Nian, 110."

As soon as she said this, a commotion swept through the class. The first few were all frequent high-scorers in Chinese. But Jiang Nian, someone who usually scored around eighty, how did he get 110?

Well, actually, the commotion was limited to the people sitting around Jiang Nian.

"For real? Jiang Nian, you wrote my student ID number, didn't you, my son?"

"It's over. We haven't seen Jiang Nian all summer, and he's already taken off."

"Damn, this is more painful than killing me! I'm begging you, just rip up the paper, buddy. How about I eat a pound of oreo-guts, and you admit you cheated?"

Using jokes to hide his癖好 (fetish)? Was he here to freeload?

The classmates were just kidding. How could you cheat in Chinese? The more you copy, the lower your score gets.

When Jiang Nian went up to the front to get his paper, he had a calm expression, but inwardly he was smug. His Chinese score was actually ten points higher than he estimated. A smooth start.

The Chinese teacher was still lecturing from the front. "Is Chinese getting harder? Where is it hard? Sometimes, for your score, you should look for the reason within yourselves, okay? It's been so long, has your grade improved?"

"Have you been seriously practicing with problems? C'mon, Chinese has always been this difficult. I really don't know how to teach you guys anymore."

In the classroom, Zhou Yuting shifted her gaze away from Jiang Nian, her brow slightly furrowed.

How did he score so high?

But she didn't pay it too much mind. For a subject like Chinese, sometimes you get lucky, and sometimes you slip up.

The third and fourth periods were Math.

After the test papers were distributed, the math teacher, a young and rather fiery man, threw a tantrum before starting to hand out the papers one by one.

When it was Jiang Nian's turn, the math teacher nodded.

"112. Not bad, a big improvement."

There were too many lopsided geniuses in math. Jiang Nian's 112 was like garbage in comparison, so it didn't attract much attention.

Only Zhou Yuting's brow furrowed deeper, a faint sense of unease growing within her.

At noon, Jiang Nian found Xu Qianqian and helped her apply medicine again in a secluded spot. Xu Qianqian's deskmate, Song Xiyun, followed them the whole time, her eyes sparkling and a shy smile on her face.

Damn, she's weird.

In the afternoon, the results for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology were released one after another.

Jiang Nian's combined science score was exactly 210, which was about what he had estimated.

Thanks to Wen Ba Dalao for the 1000 Qidian coin donation. Boss, may your waist and kidneys be strong.

(End of Chapter)
